description: This file contains the implementation of a static class 'RequiredAttributeParser' and its nested class 'DefaultRequiredAttributeParser' used for parsing required attributes in Razor TagHelpers within the OrchardCore project. It includes methods for parsing attribute selectors, handling CSS attribute syntax, and managing parsing state.

classes.name: RequiredAttributeParser
classes.description: A static class providing a method to add required attribute parsing logic to a TagMatchingRuleDescriptorBuilder.

classes.name: DefaultRequiredAttributeParser
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for parsing required attribute strings into attribute descriptors, supporting CSS selectors and wildcards.

methods.name: AddRequiredAttributes
methods.description: Public static method that initializes a DefaultRequiredAttributeParser and invokes its parsing method.

methods.name: AddRequiredAttributes
methods.description: Instance method that parses the required attributes string and adds attribute descriptors to the rule builder.

methods.name: ParsePlainSelector
methods.description: Parses a plain attribute name or wildcard from the required attributes string.

methods.name: ParseCssAttributeName
methods.description: Parses a CSS-style attribute name within a selector.

methods.name: TryParseCssValueComparison
methods.description: Attempts to parse a CSS value comparison operator (e.g., =, ^=, $=).

methods.name: TryParseCssValue
methods.description: Attempts to parse a CSS attribute value, handling quoted and unquoted values.

methods.name: TryParseCssSelector
methods.description: Parses a complete CSS attribute selector enclosed in brackets.

methods.name: EnsureNotAtEnd
methods.description: Checks if the parser has reached the end of the string, with optional diagnostic handling.

methods.name: At
methods.description: Checks if the current character matches a specified character.

methods.name: PassOptionalWhitespace
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters in the parsing process.
